title: Samurai Rabbit Showdown
description: A white rabbit samurai in orange armor and conical hat kneels in a combat stance holding a glowing pink katana. To his left, a woman in a flowing pink kimono kneels with hands pressed together in prayer, while two cyberpunk punks with green mohawk and black hair charge from both sides wielding hatchets.
prompt: A white rabbit samurai wearing detailed orange and black samurai armor with a metal conical hat, kneeling in a dramatic combat stance on a cracked street while holding a glowing pink energy katana. Beside him, a beautiful Asian woman in a vibrant pink kimono kneels with hands in prayer. Two aggressive cyberpunk punks with spiked hair and black-pink outfits charge from both sides swinging hatchets. Background features a massive gothic cathedral with pink and black striped architecture under a pink-purple dusk sky. Dust and cherry blossoms on the ground, cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting.
